channel.title: Pier & Point · Avalon at Mission Bay I
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Avalon at Mission Bay I (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Avalon at Mission Bay I: Avalon at Mission Bay I: an AvalonBay leasing flyer gives…
item.description: Avalon at Mission Bay I: an AvalonBay leasing flyer gives 255 King Street as the address of Avalon at Mission Bay; no source calls it the first of three phases. The permit's estimated cost was $12,000,000 and its revised cost $38,000,000; both are permit valuations. Source: AvalonBay leasing flyer (resource.avalonbay.com/policies/CA067/AvalonatMissionBay.pdf); DataSF Building Permits 200007155245.

item.title: Correction · Avalon at Mission Bay I: The map notes said this is Phase I of a three-phase…
item.description: The map notes said this is Phase I of a three-phase AvalonBay complex, about 250 units, built circa 2003, architect Arquitectonica. OpenStreetMap gives only the address, and the Arquitectonica page describes a 260-unit project that matches the third phase, so the notes now carry a dated correction: the Assessor roll for 255 King St shows year built 2003, 256 units and 19 stories, no source read names the architect, and the phase numbering and project name are Pier & Point's own label. The notes no longer state 'first of three phases' as fact. The June 2003 completion month (cited only to Arquitectonica's home page) is now 2003, citing the Assessor roll, and the October 2000 groundbreaking milestone (cited only to SFGate's home page, unverifiable, and with a 16-story claim contradicted by the Assessor's 19 stories) was removed. The Thy Spa listing could not be re-checked because the tenant's site blocks automated fetches, and is unchanged. Source: DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, parcel 8706010 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8706010); Arquitectonica, Avalon Mission Bay (https://arquitectonica.com/architecture/project/avalon-mission-bay/) (does not state this); OpenStreetMap way 945538326 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/945538326) (does not state this).
